title: Storehouse of Stories, A Edited by C. M. Yonge. Second series
author: Charlotte Mary Yonge
date: '1872'
genre: Fiction (by others)
publication-format: Edited book
publisher: 'London and New York: Macmillan and Company'

Like its 1870 predecessor, this was a volume of reprinted children’s stories by other hands.

The stories were \'Family Stories\', \'Elements of Morality\', \'A Puzzle for a Curious Girl\' and \'Blossoms of Morality\'.
